# US tightens military and financial pressure as Iran talks falter

US President Donald Trump speaks during the first televised Cabinet meeting at Camp David, flanked by Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, July 31, 2026.



The Trump administration on Friday outlined military and financial measures against Tehran alongside negotiations that President Donald Trump said were being undermined by Iran’s conduct.

Speaking during the first televised Cabinet meeting at Camp David, Trump, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent addressed continued talks, military action aimed at preventing Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and a worldwide search for assets linked to its government.

**Talks continue as trust erodes**

Trump said negotiations with Iran were continuing but that he was “losing faith” in Tehran because “they do lie” and “they do misrepresent.”

“They always want to talk, but they break their words so often,” he said.  
Trump said Steve Witkoff, Jared Kushner, Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio were involved in the talks. “We have great people talking,” he added.

He said five missiles were fired at a US base in Jordan while negotiations were underway.

“Instead, I got a call from Pete that they just shot five missiles at one of our bases in Jordan,” Trump said.

Asked whether the attacks could continue, Trump said: “I think I’m going to be foolish to say no. You always have to keep you

# [At Least 3 Dead in Russia and Crimea After Ukraine Strikes Industrial Sites](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/07/29/at-least-3-dead-in-russia-and-crimea-after-ukraine-strikes-industrial-sites-a93363)

## 

![](https://static.themoscowtimes.com/img/flipboard_mrrw.png)
![](https://static.themoscowtimes.com/image/article_1360/da/photo_2026-07-29_07-23-33.jpg)

Ukrainian attacks across Russia and annexed Crimea killed at least three people, authorities said Wednesday morning, as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed his military struck several industrial sites in an overnight blitz.

In a post on X, Zelensky [said](https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2082379637527609346 "said") long-range attacks targeted an oil refinery and logistics center in the central Ryazan region. He said an oil refinery in the Perm region was also hit, as well as an export terminal and defense enterprise in the southern Rostov region. 

Authorities in the Ryazan region confirmed that several industrial sites caught fire amid attacks in the capital city, adding that six people sought medical attention. They did not detail which facilities were hit.

# Boreal Gold’s ‘high-grade’ North Star shines bright

[Boreal Gold](https://borealgold.ca/) (CSE:BGLD) has reported ‘high-grade’ gold intersections from its phase four winter drilling program at the North Star Gold Project in Manitoba, Canada.

Hole GR-26-149 at the Gold Rock Vein returned 15.54 grams per tonne gold (Au) over 2.41m from 85.17m to 87.58m, including 81.5g/t Au over 0.41m.

Hole GR-26-150 returned 1.61g/t Au over 1.27m from 103.7m to 104.97m, including 10.45g/t Au over 0.17m.

The company completed 10 HQ drill holes totalling 1,326m during the winter and spring program on the Gold Rock Quartz Shear Zone. Every hole intersected the shear zone with strong alteration.

CEO Richard Masson says the program continues to return ‘high-grade’ [gold](https://mining.com.au/golds-quarter-from-safe-haven-to-new-discoveries/) from the Gold Rock Vein structure.
